title: Stop making this taxi mistake! MSFS runway incursions & hotspots tutorial
description:
Discover how one wrong turn at 5 knots can trigger a catastrophe at 160 knots in Microsoft Flight Simulator. In this in-depth MSFS tutorial, we dissect the single most critical navigation hazard in aviation: runway incursions, airport chart hotspots, and the golden rules of taxi clearances.

If you have ever wondered why "cleared to taxi" never gives you permission to cross an active runway, how to decode wigwags and stop bars in third-party sceneries, or how to avoid getting kicked off VATSIM for crossing a solid yellow line, this Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and MSFS 2020 guide breaks down everything you need to navigate airports with real-world airline discipline.

⏱️ Video Chapters:
00:00 The 5-Knot Mistake (Runway Incursions & Hotspots)
00:35 The Golden Rule: Taxi vs. Crossing Clearances
00:43 Reading Airport Chart Hotspots (HS1 & HS2 Traps)
01:17 Wigwags & Stop Bars (MSFS Scenery Reality Check)
02:38 The Holding Line Rule: Solid Wall vs. Dash Across
03:16 The 80% Trap: Ambiguous Ground ATC Instructions
03:52 Airline Cockpit Cross-Check Before Takeoff

✈️ Hardware & Platform:
- Simulators: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 / Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020
- Aircraft Featured: General Aviation & Commercial Airliners
